# DAFT
Distinguishability Analysis Framework for hardware Trojans

This repository will host the continued development of the artifact accompanying our paper "Hardware Trojans from Invisible Inversions: On the Trojanizability of Standard Cell Libraries", published at IEEE S&P 2026.

The current, formally published version of the DAFT codebase together with a reproducibility package is available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19564962
